discrepancies.pems_original: PEMS has separate protocols for Uterine Rupture, Abruptio Placenta, Childbirth/Labor/Delivery, and Eclampsia.
discrepancies.converted_text: Poquoson combined them into one general OB Emergencies protocol.
discrepancies.recommendation: While acceptable for brevity, ensure all unique criteria, signs, symptoms, and procedural steps from each of the individual PEMS protocols are included.
